text: To answer the third question, all purely anecdotal, what happened to me is that after we submitted the documents we got an appointment to show the original documents and on that occasion they also issued me a new B2 tourist visa until our appointment to have the interview. Since you are married, I imagine you would get the B1 visa when you show the documents. If your appointment to show the documents won’t be before the visa expires, try to go early in the morning if your branch allows walk ins, bring all your documents with you and ask to extend the B2 visa. They might not but worth a try.
